subject: GO v2 telemetry-driven swarm evolution, expanded live-source ecology, selective memory and bidirectional q23 bridge

observed_internal_evidence.high_churn: A prior live-fusion cut observed 48 new commits between durable-close base and initial input cut; long workers require repeated current-state and work-revision revalidation.
observed_internal_evidence.work_revision: Successful execution against an older work revision must remain diagnostic-only for current-work credit.
observed_internal_evidence.observer_backaction: Same-hot-file observation showed materially higher latency and WAL activity than isolated observation in a shadow workload; stronger networking cannot assume its control plane is free.
observed_internal_evidence.duplicate_suppression: A prior GO run successfully avoided duplicate feedback after observing that Hypofusion had already distributed the same material result.
observed_internal_evidence.correlated_replication: A second control/projection plane with correlated missing-edge ancestry did not provide independent recall evidence.

external_mechanism_packages.topic: shared selective persistent memory vs full-history bias
governed shared memory and stale/provenance failure modes

q23.message: Read GO global frontier/telemetry and accept GO KnowledgeNeeds, runtime failures and external multimodal/memory mechanisms. Return q23 packages, tests, negative results and specialist questions through the bidirectional bridge. Experience-benefit claims must preserve N=0 vs dose-response. GO activity does not override q23 falsifiers and q23 activity does not set global priority.
q23.next_test: Replay GO->q23 and q23->GO question/delta closure inside WORK-GO-SWARM-V2-DIFFERENTIAL-20260810.

frank.message: Use GO v2 as coordination/research control only; Frank architecture truth still requires Harness evidence. Consume q23/GO material deltas through current-work-bound reentry. Historical worker/route scores never become cognitive truth.
frank.next_test: Replay a stale work-revision Frank-affecting delta and verify current-work credit rejection plus preserved diagnostic value.

harness.message: Add GO-v2 differential replay/fault matrix and q23 experience-dose/test outputs to executable evidence intake. Distinguish delivery/reconstruction/plan-revalidation/use/effect and exact current-work revision.
harness.next_test: Execute WORK-GO-SWARM-V2-DIFFERENTIAL-20260810 when compatible capacity is available without displacing BASE critical path.

unifieddb.message: Support selective institutional memory, KnowledgeNeeds, provenance/revision binding, compact digests/pull-on-demand and isolated/rebuildable routing projections. Do not turn worker-local exploration into a second canonical truth store.
unifieddb.next_test: Measure selective/pull retrieval and control-plane backaction under churn/restart.

claygraph.message: Represent current dependency/hypothesis/subscription/KnowledgeNeed topology for routing and repair, not truth. Preserve ancestry edges so correlated worker/source outputs do not masquerade as replication.
claygraph.next_test: Missing/stale dependency plus correlated-ancestry route replay.

claycode.message: Ensure GO-v2 message, telemetry, work-revision, pull/ack and q23 bridge records remain expressible in ClayCode without forcing semantic changes absent executable gaps.
claycode.next_test: Compile minimal telemetry/message/reentry records once current BASE WP semantics permit.

gwt.message: If research deltas enter Frank-facing cognition, maintain exposure/use/effect separation; global broadcast volume is not causal uptake or ignition evidence.

emergenz.message: Evaluate whether richer swarm connectivity creates real causal research benefit or merely correlated consensus. Lesion routing edges, subscriptions and high-centrality sources separately.
emergenz.next_test: Compare adaptive topology vs fixed targeting with shared-ancestry controls.

hyperposition.message: Keep alternative communication/memory geometries simultaneously open: fixed targeted, adaptive targeted, subscription pull, dense fanout, local exploration/shared evidence split. Collapse only from replay telemetry.
hyperposition.next_test: Multi-topology replay under sparse versus dense invalidations.

clayresearch.message: Whole-mesh synthesis should evaluate both scientific/build progress and coordination quality. Track useful progress per coordination/resource cost rather than message/commit count.
clayresearch.next_test: Include GO-v2 telemetry and q23 bridge closure in future whole-mesh synthesis.

promotion_guard: GO v2 operating laws are fixed where owner-directed, but adaptive topology, historical worker routing priors, selective-memory policy details and control-plane placement remain empirically testable. Stronger connectivity is not promotion evidence.
shared_ancestry_rule: Distribution through multiple branches/workers never creates independent replication; source, prompt, fixture, implementation and experience ancestry must remain explicit.
